# Ukraine Support Crypto Wallets Directory

> Structured index of verified cryptocurrency wallet addresses for Ukrainian defense, medical, and humanitarian charity foundations. Available in English and Ukrainian.

Base URL: https://donate-to-ukraine.github.io/donate-crypto-ukraine
Total Funds: 15
